answers.topic: Why do you want to work here (generic)
answers.text: I'm drawn to teams that ship fast and care about craft, and I'd love to bring my design and research background to help solve real user problems here.
Senior product designer with 6 years of experience across B2B SaaS and consumer apps, focused on turning research into simple, usable interfaces.
Strong at rapid prototyping, user interviews, and translating ambiguous problems into clear design systems.

answers.topic: Why are you looking to leave your current role
answers.text: I've grown as much as I can in my current scope and I'm looking for a team with a bigger, more ambiguous design problem to own.
Led the redesign of our onboarding flow, cutting drop-off by 35% and becoming the design system's first fully accessible flagship feature.

answers.topic: How do you like to work with product managers and engineers
answers.text: I like being looped in early, before requirements are locked, so design can shape the problem rather than just the pixels.

answers.topic: When are you available to start
answers.text: I can start within 30 days of an offer, matching my current notice period.
I've spent the last several years designing for complex B2B workflows and I'm excited about the chance to bring that experience to a team building tools people rely on daily.
